title: Synthetic HTR Generator: multilingual font-rendered handwriting lines for HTR training
description:
Generator of synthetic handwritten text recognition (HTR) data by rendering text with handwriting-style fonts. Four stages: text acquisition (Wikipedia in the target language, or an external corpus line by line with --text-lines), font acquisition and per-language glyph verification, image generation with controlled paper backgrounds and three perturbation levels, and splitting with per-sample metadata. Declarative per-language configuration (37 Latin-script languages). Version 1.0.0 is the version used in the article Synthetic Handwriting for HTR Fine-Tuning: Controlled Evaluation Across Languages, Domains and Data Sizes. Fonts are not distributed.
